name: palamnerpalace
description: Palamner Palace — Full MERN Stack Social Commerce Marketplace

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,yellow" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix server run type-check && npm --prefix client run type-check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
